auth.title: The provider rejected the key
auth.action: Check the API key and that it can use this model.

rate-limit.title: Too many requests, or no credits left
rate-limit.action: Wait a minute, or check your plan and credits with the provider.

not-found.title: Address or model not found
not-found.action: Check the base URL and the model name.

bad-request.title: The provider refused the request
bad-request.action: Check the model name. Some models don't support this kind of call.

server.title: The provider is having trouble
server.action: Try again in a few minutes.

network.title: Couldn't reach the provider
network.action: Check your connection and the base URL. If both are right, this provider may block calls from browsers (CORS).

local-unreachable.title: Couldn't reach {{name}} on this computer
local-unreachable.action: Check that it's running and allows this site. {{hint}}

timeout.title: The provider took too long
timeout.action: Try again, or pick a faster model.

invalid-response.title: Unexpected response format
invalid-response.action: Check that the base URL points to an OpenAI-compatible API (it usually ends in /v1).

invalid-output.title: The model didn't return what was asked
invalid-output.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, pick a more capable model.

localHint.ollama: Start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS={{origin}} ollama serve
localHint.lmstudio: In LM Studio, turn on "Enable CORS" in the server settings.
localHint.other: Allow the origin {{origin}} in the server's CORS settings.

stt.not-allowed: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's address bar, or type your answer.
stt.no-microphone: No microphone found. Connect one, or type your answer.
stt.network: Speech recognition lost its connection. Type your answer or try again.
stt.unsupported: This browser can't transcribe speech. Type your answer instead.
stt.unknown: Speech recognition stopped. Type your answer or try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Melete talks straight from this browser to the model you pick. There's no Melete server in between.
settings.firstRun: Pick a provider and paste your key to start practicing.

llm.title: Language model
llm.apiKeyHint: Stored only in this browser (IndexedDB) and sent only to {{name}}. Never included in exports.
llm.modelHint: Type a model name or load the list from the provider.
llm.noModels: The provider didn't return a model list. Type the name.
llm.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL, like https://api.example.com/v1
llm.localNotice: {{name}} runs on your computer: free, and nothing leaves your machine.

voice.title: Voice
voice.googleWarningTitle: Chrome sends your voice to Google
voice.googleWarning: Speech recognition in Chrome runs on Google's servers. Only the transcript is saved here; the audio is never stored. Choose "Type only" if you'd rather not.
voice.unsupported: You can still answer by typing. For voice, use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
voice.noVoices: No voices for this language in this browser.

language.title: Language
language.interviewHint: The language the interviewer speaks and you answer in.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Stories, sessions and transcripts live only in this browser. Exports never include your API key.
data.importFailed: This file isn't a Melete export.
data.wipeBody: Stories, sessions, transcripts and settings (including the key) will be removed. Export first if you want a copy.

stories.title: Stories
stories.description: Real situations from your work that you want to tell in interviews. The interviewer builds questions around them.
stories.importFailed: This file isn't a Melete export.
stories.emptyBody: Write the first one: a real situation, what you had to do, what you did and how it ended. Interviews still work without stories, but questions get more personal with them.

editor.description: Use the STAR structure. Write it the way you'd tell it, with real numbers when you have them.
editor.title: Title
editor.situationHint: Context: where you were, what was going on.
editor.actionHint: What you did, in first person.
editor.resultHint: How it ended, with numbers when you have them.
editor.tagsHint: Type and press Enter. Tags help the interviewer pick the right story.
editor.deleteBody: Past sessions keep their questions and transcripts.

newInterview.title: New interview
newInterview.description: Set it up like the interview you're preparing for. The questions are planned when you start.
newInterview.jobDescriptionHint: Paste the job post to get questions aimed at it.
newInterview.followUpsHint: At most one per question, only when part of the answer is missing.
newInterview.storiesUsed_one: Questions will draw on your {{count}} story.
newInterview.storiesUsed_other: Questions will draw on your {{count}} stories.
newInterview.noStories: You have no stories yet, so questions will be generic.

room.leaveBody: Answers you already sent stay saved. The session will be marked as abandoned.
room.planningHint: This takes a few seconds with most models.
room.typePlaceholder: Write your answer the way you'd say it.
room.reviewHint: Fix anything the recognition got wrong before sending.
room.emptyTranscript: Nothing was captured. Record again or type your answer.
room.abandoned: This interview was left before the end.

feedback.improvedAnswerHint: Same facts, better told. Fill in anything in [brackets].

report.title: Report
report.noSummaryAbandoned: This interview ended early, so there's no session summary. Answers that were evaluated are below.
report.question: Question {{n}}
report.noAnswers: No answers were sent in this session.
report.deleteBody: Its questions, transcripts and feedback will be removed from this browser.

history.title: History
history.description: Every interview you did in this browser.
history.emptyBody: Start one and its report will show up here.
